name: brix-signage
description: Manage Brix digital signage screens, playlists, schedules, media and emergency messages through the hosted Brix MCP server, with the brix-signage skill bundled.

api_key.label: Brix API key
api_key.description: A Brix API key from the Brix console (Settings > AI, API & MCP > API keys). A view-only key is a safe first try. Leave empty to sign in with OAuth instead (see the README).
